trial_title: Safety and Tolerability of Ertapenem Sodium in the Treatment of Complicated Urinary Tract Infections (0826-055)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine the efficacy of ertapenem sodium (Invanz) in treatment of complicated urinary tract infections with respect to the proportion of patients with a favorable microbiological response at 5-9 days post therapy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Adult patients with a suspected or documented complicated urinary tract infection
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of complicated UTIs, which meets the inclusion criterion.

eligibility_table.criterion: Female patients must test negative for pregnancy and agree to use adequate birth control measures
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a positive serum β-hCG level indicating pregnancy, thus does not meet the requirement to test negative for pregnancy.

eligibility_table.criterion: Nursing women must agree to defer breastfeeding until 5 days after completion of all study antibiotic therapy
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not a nursing woman, so this criterion does not apply.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient confirmed that she will defer breastfeeding for at least 5 days after completing all study antibiotic therapy?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with complete obstruction of any portion of the urinary tract
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about any obstruction of the urinary tract, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have evidence of complete obstruction in any portion of the urinary tract as confirmed by imaging studies?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients with rapidly progressive or terminal illness
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information indicating the presence of a rapidly progressive or terminal illness, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a prognosis of less than 6 months to live due to a rapidly progressive or terminal illness?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about renal transplant status, making it indeterminate.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a history of renal transplantation?

attention_flags: EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Patients with complete obstruction of any portion of the urinary tract
EXCLUSION UNCLEAR: Patients with rapidly progressive or terminal illness
